summary: Seconds to display strings: mm:ss, hh:mm:ss, and a compact "1h 6m" form.
overview: Turns a raw seconds float into the string a player reads. Takes floats rather than TimeSpan specifically so it drops straight into a Time.deltaTime-driven countdown with no conversion step in between.
useCases: Cooldown and countdown timers on the HUD.
Playtime and best-time stats on a results or profile screen.
A compact remaining-time label where mm:ss would be too precise to be useful.

gotchas.title: Negative input clamps to zero
gotchas.body: A countdown that overshoots past zero shows 00:00 rather than a negative time. If you need to know it overshot, check the value before formatting it.

gotchas.title: Seconds are floored, not rounded
gotchas.body: 59.9 seconds displays as 00:59, so a timer appears to reach zero a moment before it actually does. That is the conventional behaviour for a countdown, but it matters if the display is meant to match a logged value.
